lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance pixel clusters located posterior to the gill slits, aligned in horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a series of node-like features across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear ridges visible on the upper flank, showing a distinct light-to-shadow gradient transition from the dorsal to ventral direction.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs observed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, most concentrated near the leading edge and base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or indentation is visible on the posterior (trailing) edge of the right pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated silhouettes with distinct horizontal stripes swimming in close proximity to the ventral region, identifying as remoras.
